note: Researched November 2026 from public summaries of each state statute; re-check yearly. No penalties stored (sources disagreed).

states.name: Alabama
states.cap: One month's rent (extra deposits allowed for pets, alterations or increased liability risk)
states.returnDays: 60 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives back possession
states.itemize: A written itemized list of any deductions

states.name: Alaska
states.cap: Two months' rent (no limit when the monthly rent is over $2,000)
states.returnDays: 14 days after the tenancy ends if the tenant gave proper notice, otherwise 30 days
states.itemize: A written itemized statement of the deductions and the reasons for them
states.notes: Deposits must be kept in a trust account or held by an escrow agent.

states.name: Arizona
states.cap: One and a half months' rent
states.returnDays: 14 days after the tenancy ends and possession is returned (not counting weekends and legal holidays)
states.itemize: An itemized list of deductions
states.moveIn: Landlords must give new tenants a signed move-in form for noting existing damage, and tell them they may be present at the move-out inspection
states.notes: The lease must say which fees and deposits are refundable.

states.name: Arkansas
states.returnDays: 60 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant moves out
states.itemize: A written itemized list of damages and deductions
states.notes: These rules do not apply to landlords who own five or fewer units unless a third party manages them for a fee.

states.name: California
states.cap: One month's rent (two months for small landlords: natural persons or family LLCs owning no more than two properties with four units in total)
states.returnDays: 21 days after the tenant moves out
states.itemize: An itemized statement of deductions, with receipts or invoices for work or materials of $125 or more
states.moveIn: Landlords must take photos of the unit before the tenant moves in (tenancies starting on or after July 1, 2025), and before and after repairs at move-out (from April 1, 2025)
states.notes: The one-month cap (AB 12) applies from July 1, 2024; some cities, such as Los Angeles and San Francisco, require landlords to pay interest on deposits.

states.name: Colorado
states.returnDays: One month after the lease ends or the tenant gives up the unit, or up to 60 days if the lease says so
states.itemize: A written statement listing the exact reasons for any deductions
states.notes: HB 25-1249, in force from January 1, 2026, rewrote the deposit rules, treating the deposit as the tenant's money and defining bad-faith withholding.

states.name: Connecticut
states.cap: Two months' rent (one month if the tenant is 62 or older)
states.returnDays: 21 days after the tenancy ends, or 15 days after receiving the tenant's forwarding address if later
states.itemize: A written itemized statement of damages
states.interest: Interest must be paid at the rate set each year by the Banking Commissioner

states.name: Delaware
states.cap: One month's rent for leases of one year or longer (no limit for furnished units)
states.returnDays: 20 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written itemized list of damages and their estimated cost
states.notes: Deposits must be kept in a separate security deposit account, and a tenant may offer a surety bond instead.

states.name: District of Columbia
states.returnDays: 45 days after the tenancy ends, with any balance and an itemized statement within 30 days of a notice to withhold
states.itemize: A written notice of intent to withhold, then an itemized statement of the deductions
states.interest: The deposit must be held in an interest-bearing account and the interest paid to the tenant

states.name: Florida
states.returnDays: 15 days after the tenant moves out if nothing is claimed, or written notice of a claim within 30 days
states.itemize: A written notice of the claim and the reason for it, sent to the tenant's last known address
states.interest: Interest is owed only if the deposit is held in an interest-bearing account (75% of the interest earned or 5% a year)
states.notes: Since 2023, landlords may offer a non-refundable monthly fee instead of a deposit (§ 83.491).

states.name: Georgia
states.cap: Two months' rent (leases made or renewed from July 1, 2024)
states.returnDays: One month after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written statement listing the exact reasons for any deductions
states.moveIn: Landlords must give the tenant a list of existing damage before the tenancy starts, which the tenant may inspect and sign
states.notes: The two-month cap came from the Safe at Home Act (HB 404, 2024); landlords with ten or fewer units who manage them themselves are exempt from some of the rules.

states.name: Hawaii
states.cap: One month's rent (plus a pet deposit of up to one month's rent)
states.returnDays: 14 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written itemized statement of damages and deductions
states.moveIn: Landlords must inventory the unit and give the tenant a written record of its condition before the tenancy starts
states.notes: If no move-in inventory is made, the unit's condition at move-out is presumed to be the same as at move-in.

states.name: Idaho
states.returnDays: 21 days after the tenancy ends, or up to 30 days if the lease says so
states.itemize: A signed statement itemizing the deductions

states.name: Illinois
states.returnDays: 45 days after the tenant moves out, or 30 days to send an itemized statement if deductions are made (landlords with 5 or more units)
states.itemize: An itemized statement of damage with paid receipts or estimates, which may be sent by email to a verified address
states.interest: Landlords with 25 or more units must pay interest on deposits held more than six months
states.statute: Security Deposit Return Act, 765 ILCS 710; Security Deposit Interest Act, 765 ILCS 715
states.notes: Chicago's Residential Landlord and Tenant Ordinance has stricter deposit, interest and receipt rules.

states.name: Indiana
states.returnDays: 45 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives a mailing address
states.itemize: An itemized list of damages claimed, with the amount of each
states.notes: Some cities, such as Bloomington, have local rules on joint move-in inspections.

states.name: Iowa
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives a mailing address
states.itemize: A written statement showing the specific reason for withholding any part of the deposit
states.interest: Interest earned in the first five years of a tenancy belongs to the landlord

states.name: Kansas
states.cap: One month's rent unfurnished, one and a half months furnished, plus up to half a month extra for pets
states.returnDays: Within 14 days after the amount due is determined, and no later than 30 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written itemization of deductions
states.moveIn: Landlord and tenant must jointly inventory the unit within five days of move-in

states.name: Kentucky
states.itemize: An itemized list of damages after a move-out inspection, which the tenant may inspect and dispute
states.moveIn: Before taking a deposit the landlord must give the tenant a list of existing damage, which the tenant may inspect and sign
states.notes: These rules apply only in cities and counties that have adopted the Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act (such as Louisville and Lexington).

states.name: Louisiana
states.returnDays: One month after the lease ends, with up to 15 more days for the itemized statement (from August 1, 2026)
states.itemize: An itemized statement accounting for any amount kept, with the reasons
states.statute: Louisiana Revised Statutes 9:3251–3254 (amended by Act 63 of 2026)
states.notes: Act 63 of 2026 (HB 292), effective August 1, 2026, added the extra 15 days for the itemized statement; the refund itself stays due within one month.

states.name: Maine
states.returnDays: 30 days after a written lease ends, or 21 days after a tenancy at will ends
states.itemize: A written itemized statement of the reasons for keeping any part of the deposit
states.notes: Deposits must be kept in an account separate from the landlord's own funds.

states.name: Maryland
states.cap: One month's rent (leases made or renewed from October 1, 2024)
states.returnDays: 45 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written list of damages and costs, sent by first-class mail within 45 days
states.moveIn: The tenant may ask for an inspection with the landlord within 15 days of moving in and receive a written list of existing damage
states.interest: Simple interest at the one-year US Treasury rate set each January, or 1.5% a year if higher, on deposits of $50 or more
states.notes: The Renters' Rights and Stabilization Act of 2024 cut the cap from two months' rent to one.

states.name: Massachusetts
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: An itemized list of damages signed under penalties of perjury, with written evidence of repair costs
states.moveIn: The landlord must give a written statement of the unit's condition within 10 days of the tenancy starting or the deposit being paid
states.interest: 5% a year (or the bank's rate if lower), paid each year
states.notes: The deposit must be held in a separate interest-bearing account in a Massachusetts bank.

states.name: Michigan
states.cap: One and a half months' rent
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: An itemized list of damages with estimated costs, sent by first-class mail
states.moveIn: The landlord must give the tenant two copies of a blank inventory checklist at move-in, to be returned within seven days
states.notes: The tenant must give a forwarding address within four days of moving out.

states.name: Minnesota
states.returnDays: 21 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives a mailing address
states.itemize: A written statement of the reasons for withholding any part of the deposit

states.name: Mississippi
states.returnDays: 45 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written itemization of amounts withheld

states.name: Missouri
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written itemized list of damages
states.notes: The landlord must give reasonable notice of the move-out inspection so the tenant can attend.

states.name: Montana
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends (10 days if nothing is deducted)
states.itemize: A written itemized list of deductions with the balance
states.moveIn: A landlord who takes a deposit must give the tenant a written statement of the condition of the premises at the start of the lease
states.notes: A landlord who does not send the written list of deductions in time loses the right to withhold for damage or cleaning.

states.name: Nebraska
states.cap: One month's rent, plus a pet deposit of up to one quarter of a month's rent
states.returnDays: 14 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant asks for it and gives an address
states.itemize: A written itemization of deductions

states.name: Nevada
states.cap: Three months' rent (deposit and surety bond combined)
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: An itemized written accounting of deductions
states.moveIn: The rental agreement must include a signed record of the inventory and condition of the premises

states.name: New Hampshire
states.cap: One month's rent or $100, whichever is greater
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written itemized list of damages and the cost of repairs
states.moveIn: The landlord's deposit receipt must tell the tenant they have 5 days to give a written list of existing damage
states.interest: Interest is due on deposits held for a year or longer

states.name: New Jersey
states.cap: One and a half months' rent
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends (5 business days after a fire, flood or condemnation)
states.itemize: An itemized list of deductions, sent by certified or registered mail
states.interest: The deposit must be held in a New Jersey bank account and the interest paid or credited to the tenant every year
states.statute: New Jersey Rent Security Deposit Act, N.J.S.A. 46:8-19 to 46:8-26
states.notes: Landlords must tell the tenant in writing, within 30 days, the name and address of the bank holding the deposit.

states.name: New Mexico
states.cap: One month's rent for a rental agreement of less than one year; no limit for longer agreements
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: An itemized written list of deductions
states.interest: Interest is due each year when a deposit over one month's rent is taken on a lease of a year or more

states.name: New York
states.returnDays: 14 days after the tenant moves out
states.itemize: An itemized statement of the reasons for any amount kept
states.moveIn: Landlords must offer the tenant an inspection before move-in, and a written agreement on the unit's condition
states.interest: Deposits in buildings with six or more units must be kept in an interest-bearing account for the tenant
states.statute: New York General Obligations Law §§ 7-103 and 7-108
states.notes: The one-month cap and inspection rules come from the Housing Stability and Tenant Protection Act of 2019; tenants can also ask for an inspection before moving out.

states.name: North Carolina
states.cap: Two weeks' rent (week-to-week), one and a half months (month-to-month) or two months (longer terms)
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends (an interim account then, and a final one within 60 days if the claim is not yet known)
states.itemize: An itemized list of damages
states.notes: Deposits must be held in a trust account at an insured bank or covered by a bond, and the tenant told where.

states.name: North Dakota
states.cap: One month's rent (more for some tenants with past rental judgments), plus a pet deposit of up to $2,500 or two months' rent, whichever is greater
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant returns possession
states.itemize: An itemized list of amounts withheld
states.moveIn: The landlord must give the tenant a written statement of the unit's condition when the rental agreement is made, signed by both
states.interest: The deposit must be kept in an insured interest-bearing account and interest paid to the tenant unless the tenancy lasted under nine months

states.name: Ohio
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives possession
states.itemize: An itemized written notice of deductions, sent to the forwarding address the tenant gives
states.interest: 5% a year on any amount over $50 or one month's rent (whichever is greater) when the tenant stays six months or more

states.name: Oklahoma
states.returnDays: 45 days after the tenancy ends, possession is returned and the tenant asks in writing
states.itemize: A written itemized list of deductions
states.notes: Deposits must be kept in an escrow account in a federally insured bank or similar institution in Oklahoma.

states.name: Oregon
states.returnDays: 31 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives up possession
states.itemize: A written accounting of the basis for any amount kept
states.notes: Portland has its own stricter deposit rules under its tenant protections ordinance.

states.name: Pennsylvania
states.cap: Two months' rent in the first year, one month's rent after that
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends or the tenant gives up possession
states.itemize: A written list of damages, sent to the tenant's forwarding address
states.interest: Deposits over $100 held more than two years must earn interest, paid to the tenant (less a 1% fee) from the third year
states.statute: Pennsylvania Landlord and Tenant Act of 1951, 68 P.S. §§ 250.511a to 250.512
states.notes: Philadelphia passed an ordinance in September 2025 on paying security deposits in installments.

states.name: Rhode Island
states.returnDays: 20 days after the tenancy ends, the tenant gives up possession and provides a forwarding address
states.itemize: A written itemized list of damages and deductions

states.name: South Carolina
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives up possession
states.itemize: Written notice itemizing the amounts withheld

states.name: South Dakota
states.cap: One month's rent, unless special conditions justify more
states.returnDays: 21 days after the tenancy ends and the landlord receives the tenant's mailing address (from July 1, 2026; previously two weeks)
states.itemize: A written itemized accounting of deductions, within 45 days if the tenant asks for one
states.notes: The return deadline was extended from two weeks to 21 days by Senate Bill 4.

states.name: Tennessee
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends
states.itemize: A written itemized list of damages and their estimated cost after a move-out inspection
states.notes: The deposit rules come from the Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act, which applies only in the more populous counties, so check whether it covers yours.

states.name: Texas
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenant moves out, once the tenant has given a forwarding address
states.itemize: A written itemized list of deductions (not needed if the tenant owes rent and nothing else is disputed)

states.name: Utah
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends, or 15 days after receiving the tenant's forwarding address, whichever is later
states.itemize: A written itemization of deductions
states.moveIn: Before the lease starts, the owner must give the renter a written inventory of the unit's condition (Utah Code § 57-22-4)
states.notes: A tenant must usually send the landlord the statutory written demand before suing over a late deposit.

states.name: Vermont
states.returnDays: 14 days after the tenant vacates (60 days for seasonal rentals)
states.itemize: A written statement itemizing any deductions
states.notes: A landlord who misses the 14-day deadline forfeits the right to keep any part of the deposit.

states.name: Virginia
states.returnDays: 45 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant vacates
states.itemize: A written itemized list of deductions
states.moveIn: Landlords must give the tenant a written report of existing damage within 5 days after the tenant moves in
states.notes: The former interest requirement was repealed with effect from January 1, 2015.

states.name: Washington
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant vacates
states.itemize: A full and specific written statement of the reasons for withholding, with supporting documentation
states.moveIn: A deposit can only be taken with a written lease and a written checklist of the unit's condition and cleanliness given to the tenant at move-in
states.notes: Several cities, including Seattle, add stricter local deposit rules.

states.name: West Virginia
states.returnDays: 60 days after the tenancy ends, or 45 days after a new tenant moves in, whichever is earlier
states.itemize: A written itemized list of deductions

states.name: Wisconsin
states.returnDays: 21 days after the tenant vacates
states.itemize: A written itemized statement of deductions
states.moveIn: Before taking a deposit, landlords must tell tenants in writing they have 7 days after moving in to inspect and note existing damage on a check-in sheet
states.statute: Wisconsin Statutes § 704.28 and Wis. Admin. Code ATCP 134.06

states.name: Wyoming
states.returnDays: 30 days after the tenancy ends or 15 days after receiving the tenant's forwarding address, whichever is later (30 days more if there is damage)
states.itemize: A written itemized list of deductions
states.notes: Any non-refundable part of a deposit must be stated in the lease.
